observed_change: NRC Web-Based ADAMS retired on 2026-02-27 per NRC ADAMS public documents page
why_it_matters: rev0368/rev0369 EOF LER/no-LER watch cannot rely on stale Web-Based ADAMS instructions
required_revision_behavior: Use current ADAMS Public Search or PDR/FOIA route; record accession numbers and search route in sidecar.
reject_if: claim says no LER found without current-route search metadata

observed_change: EOF power-loss trigger remains NRC Event Notification 58200 unless superseding regulatory records are imported
why_it_matters: event notification is a trigger, not restoral or recurrence-prevention proof
required_revision_behavior: Track LER/no-LER disposition, inspection follow-up, CAP/root-cause, repair work order, and retest evidence.
reject_if: event notification alone is credited as repair/retest evidence

observed_change: PDR/FOIA route may be needed when public-search UI does not expose the record
why_it_matters: missing search result is not evidence that a record does not exist
required_revision_behavior: Record search terms, date, route, accession IDs, and whether PDR/FOIA follow-up was triggered.
reject_if: absence of result is treated as no-record disposition
